capabilities: Add a reveal button to the top of the File Explorer
Scroll the File Explorer to the active file
Invoke the built-in reveal-active-file command with one click
extras: Notes that the first click may not scroll to the exact position in large vaults and recommends a second click; testers of version 1.0.0 must remove the old pre-rename version.
intentEvidence: This is a convenient addition to these built-in options already included in Obsidian
problem: Revealing the active file in the File Explorer requires running a command or using a pane menu option instead of one click.

relations.evidence: This code is heavily based on Nathan Smith's Collapse All plugin
Use this if you always want the navigator to show the active file

summary: File Explorer add-on that adds a single-click button to scroll the File Explorer to and highlight the currently active file.
